title: linanthus californicus subsp. tomentosus
intro: Linanthus californicus subsp. tomentosus, commonly known as California mountain woolly monkey flower, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the phlox family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues. It is believed to offer health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory problems due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Linanthus californicus subsp. tomentosus include flavonoids and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation.
